overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the ethics-code topic arose unexpectedly in a Commission status report listed on the notice, so it was not reasonably anticipated. The AG encouraged more detailed notice topics for such reports, but ordered nothing.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Assembly discussed a county code of ethical conduct at its September 6 meeting, a topic not listed on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because the topic was unanticipated, we find that the Assembly did not violate the Open Meeting Law by pursuing the brief discussion of the topic at its meeting.
